projectDescription: Automated web service that generates and maintains llms.txt files for websites with real-time crawling and scheduled updates
keyFeatures: Intelligent BFS web crawling with configurable depth and page limits
Real-time WebSocket streaming for live crawl progress and logs
Playwright-based JavaScript rendering via Brightdata proxy integration
AI-powered content optimization using LLM enhancement (Grok 4.1-Fast)
Automated scheduled recrawls via AWS Lambda and EventBridge
Persistent storage with Cloudflare R2 and Supabase PostgreSQL
Production-ready AWS ECS Fargate deployment with auto-scaling
API key authentication and CORS protection for security
publicApiSurface: WebSocket /ws/crawl - Real-time crawling endpoint with authentication
POST /auth/token - Generate JWT token for WebSocket authentication
POST /internal/hooks/site-changed - Webhook for manual site update triggers
LLMCrawler class - Core web crawler with BFS traversal and JS support
format_llms_txt() - Format crawled pages into llms.txt specification
save_llms_txt() - Upload generated files to R2 storage
save_site_metadata() - Track crawled sites in Supabase database
